fields.title: Water-control installed costs
fields.finding: Drainage retention, low-emittance switching, cover hardware, heaters, cables and power-system installation are unpriced. Battery conversion uses the inherited 108 usable Wh/kg planning assumption; no mass-free mitigation is credited.
fields.missing_evidence: An installed bill and wet-environment performance for the selected mitigation.
